name: QSC_IMP_PROD_GROUP_ITEMS
description: Interface table for product group item associations. The WHO column in this table, just reflects when the data was loaded into the interface table or when it was processed. These columns are for information purpose only and it will not be used during actual import into fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups data into a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the row to be processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: For Internal Use. Used to evaluate the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Item Number

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Item Name

columns.name: ITEM_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original Item System Reference

columns.name: INV_ORG_CODE
columns.description: Inventory Organization Code for the organization that the item belongs to.

columns.name: PG_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Reference Number. Used for integration with external systems. Stores the unique identifier of the product group in the source system.

columns.name: PG_INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Internal name for product groups.

columns.name: ITEM_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Name of the source system, the item was imported from.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Individual System Task Id  for each input csv file.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Product group identifier in fusion base table.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing Product group item identifier in fusion.

columns.name: ADMIN_REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Used for internal processing. The revision number of the workspace version.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Inventory Item Identifier in fusion.

columns.name: INV_ORG_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Item organization identifier in fusion.

columns.name: ITEM_ORIG_SYSTEM_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Stores the original system reference identifier of the item.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the item is active in the group.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the item is active in the product group

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which item is not active in the product group

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Manually set display order for items in a product group.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by the file import wizard to relate a row in the interface table to the data file that was uploaded.
